The '''Battle of Ord Janon''' took place in the first year of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] and resulted in a victory for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. The victory lead the Republic [[HoloNet News/Legends|media]] to report that the Separatists were on the run. [[Count of Serenno/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], labeled Republic reports mentioning the Confederate withdrawal from the "temporary" worlds of Ord Janon and [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] as "spurious" in a response transmitted by the [[Shadowfeed/Legends|CIS Shadowfeed]].<ref name="Shadowfeed" />
